summary: Local Health and Wellness reports on Sarah Whitmore's "Empower Your Life: Goal Setting and Resilience Building" workshop series, held in autumn 2023. The sessions covered SMART goals, emotional intelligence, growth mindset, resiliency toolkits, habit formation, metacognition, wellness technology, and community accountability, each led by a different expert. The article concludes that these workshops give practical tools and community support for personal growth.
one_line: A report on Sarah Whitmore's autumn 2023 "Empower Your Life" workshop series on goal setting, resilience, emotional intelligence, habits, and community support.
key_facts: Sarah Whitmore, a life coach and resiliency trainer, hosted the workshop series "Empower Your Life: Goal Setting and Resilience Building," which the author attended starting September 15, 2023.

Whitmore's workshops rest on two pillars: clarity in goal setting and developing resilience to life's challenges; participants receive reflective journals and personalized resilience assessments beforehand.
On September 22, 2023, the first workshop introduced the SMART framework: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound.
Attendee Johnathan Lee said he had been setting goals that were too vague or unrealistic, and that refining them was "a game-changer."
On September 29, 2023, clinical psychologist Dr. Emily Hanson led a seminar on emotional intelligence with exercises in mindfulness, self-awareness, and empathy.
On October 6, 2023, positive psychology expert Charlie Gardener presented fixed versus growth mindsets, a concept initially propounded by psychologist Carol Dweck.
On October 13, 2023, resilience coach Laura Simmons led participants in building personal resiliency toolkits with stress management techniques, a support system map, and learning resources.
On October 20, 2023, neuroscientist Dr. Alex Bernard spoke on neuroplasticity and forming positive habits, including group discussions on daily routines.
On October 27, 2023, holistic wellness coach Maya Robinson taught metacognitive strategies such as journaling, self-questioning, and reflective meditation.
On November 3, 2023, app developers and behavioral scientists showcased wellness apps for tracking progress, self-care reminders, and virtual support communities.
Participant Sophia Alvarez said knowing others are on similar journeys matters: "It's not just about individual success—it's about collective empowerment."
Whitmore ended each workshop by setting up an ongoing support group that meets virtually or in person for accountability.
Local health enthusiast Michael Thompson called the workshops "a lifeline for many of us" for managing everyday stress.
